files.content:
name: CI
on:
  push:
    branch: [main]
  pull_request:
jobs:
  test:
    runs_on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm test
        timeout: 10
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    steps:
      - name: Build

services:
  web:
    image: nginx:latest
    port:
      - "80:80"
    depends_on:
      - db
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost"]
      interval: 30
  db:
    image: postgres:16

[build-system]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[project]
name = "demo"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = 3.11
dependencies = "requests>=2"

[tool.ruff]
line_length = 100
